title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an organization's seed load resolves people through its membership, reports a refused reference probe, and writes as that organization
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33207
Fixes #33206

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: under a walled tenancy posture (`isolated` or `group`), every read and by-id write a seed write performs or triggers (a hook's `ctx.api` read, the engine's own reads on that row, the loader's update of an existing row and its pass-2 back-fill) is scoped to the organization the row is written as, where it reached every organization's rows. Widened: on a load for one organization, a person reference resolves to a member of that organization, `sys_organization` to the load's own, an object no organization walls (no `organization_id` column and no tenant field) across organizations, and a hook on a seeded row sees the organization the row is written as. Nothing that resolved before stops resolving; no load that succeeded is refused.
Metadata-protocol: none

**Contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (narrowing):** round 1 FAIL on `3c36f9c6e` (one must-fix, two should-fix, three nits). The fixes are on this head; the same reviewer owes the delta review before the seat lands it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:按组织回放种子数据时,人员引用改为只在该组织成员中解析(非成员绝不借用);被数据库拒绝的引用查询如实报出;种子写入带上行所属组织,hook 能看到 `organizationId`。
- 为什么改:下游应用在 18.4.0 上发现,演示数据里的负责人全部落空、依赖组织的 system hook 什么也算不出,样例数据无法作为标准种子交付。
- 风险与回滚:BREAKING——walled 模式下种子写入触发的 hook 和引擎读取只能看到该行所属组织的数据(此前能看到所有组织);只改 `seed-loader.ts`,回滚即还原该文件。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` 的 `resolveFromDatabase` / `probeScopeOf` / `probeOrganizationMember`,以及 `loadDatasets` 里 `seedOptions` 的赋值。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`,预期 17 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,增量合约复审通过后由席位落地。

## What changes

**#33207: references on an organization's own load.** `resolveFromDatabase` AND-scoped every probe with `organization_id`, `sys_user` included. `sys_user` has no such column, so the SQL driver refused the probe (`INVALID_FILTER`), the bare `catch` read it as "no match", and the reference was reported as "no such sys_user row exists". Measured on `main` 6e1ab9b2 with the real AppPlugin replayer, ObjectQL and SqlDriver: the single-tenant boot resolved `rep: 'Zhang Wei'` to `usr_zhang`; both per-organization replays left it `null`, the member's organization included.

Each target is now judged once per load (`probeScopeOf`) from the definition the stamp already reads:

1. carries an `organization_id` column (declared or injected), or cannot be described: filtered to the load's organization, as before;
2. `sys_user`: candidates by the field, read in id order page by page (50 a page) until one holds a `sys_member` row in the load's organization (`probeOrganizationMember`). A same-named person outside it is never used, and "not a member" is said only after every candidate was asked;
3. `sys_organization`: the load's own organization only;
4. no organization column, author-owned (no `managedBy`) and resolving no tenant field at all (`resolveTenantFieldName`, the reading the wall scopes by): global, unscoped. An object walled by another tenant column (`tenancy.tenantField`) and platform-managed tables without the column keep the old probe, and its refusal is now reported.

A load with no organization probes unscoped, exactly as before.

**The narrowed catch.** A refused probe records its code and the chain moves on. The load is never refused for it. One `warn` per target, field and code per load; the pass-2 error keeps its first sentence and appends the refusal's code (or, for a person outside the organization, that the person is not a member) instead of claiming no row exists.

**#33206: the organization in the write context.** `ExecutionContext` has no `organizationId` key: a hook's `session.organizationId` and its `ctx.api` scope are built from `tenantId` (measured: the card's `{ ...SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT, organizationId }` reaches no hook). The loader now builds its options bag per load: `{ context: { ...SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT, tenantId } }`, with `tenantId` the organization the load stamps its rows with (`config.organizationId ?? fallbackOrgId`, the seat's ruling on the shape note). A row that supplies its own, different `organization_id` is written as that organization (`writeOptionsFor`): its insert or update, and its pass-2 back-fill, so a walled by-id write finds the row; a batch holds rows of one write organization. `SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT` is unchanged. A load with no organization, pinned or derived, uses the frozen `SEED_OPTIONS` bag itself. The landed-key ledger insert uses the per-load bag.

A pass-2 back-fill whose update answers `null` (the data-engine contract's "matched no row") is reported as a failed back-fill, never counted as resolved. ObjectQL itself already refuses a by-id update it cannot find with a not-found error, which the back-fill reports.

`skipTriggers` does not stop hooks: it reaches only the record-change trigger's flow dispatch, and `triggerHooks` skips metadata hooks only on `skipAutomations`. So the card's premise stands: app hooks run on seed writes.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts` (real AppPlugin, its walled `seed-replayer` and its `single` inline seed, SeedLoaderService, ObjectQL, SqlDriver over better-sqlite3), 17 cases:

- a member of the load organization is resolved (`rep` and `owner_id`);
- a same-named person who is not a member is NOT resolved (two people named Wang Fang, one per organization, the other organization's created first; Zhang Wei, a member of North only, is not given to South);
- a member among sixty same-named people (more than one page) is found, and "not a member" is said only after all were asked;
- a refused probe is reported with its code, once per target, field and code;
- a global catalog resolves; an object walled by `tenantField: 'workspace_id'` is not taken for global (another organization's row is not borrowed); the organization table answers only for the load organization;
- CONTROL: a tenant-carrying target is still filtered (South's `Globex` is not borrowed by North);
- CONTROL: a load with no organization probes unscoped, with no membership asked;
- a hook sees the load organization on a replay, a reseed, the `single` boot (sole organization) and a direct pinned load (the install path);
- a row that supplies its own organization is written as it, its pass-2 back-fill included (walled posture);
- a pass-2 back-fill the write organization cannot see is reported, not counted as resolved;
- CONTROL: a load with no organization writes with the seed posture unchanged (`session` equals `{ isSystem, skipTriggers }`);
- the declared narrowing: under `isolated` and under `group`, a hook's `ctx.api` read on a seeded row sees only the load organization.

And one case in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader-deferred-failure.test.ts`: an engine `update` answering `null` on the back-fill is reported at `error` with "matched no row" and is not counted as resolved.

## Acceptance notes

- AppPlugin's no-metadata fallback (a basic insert per record when the metadata service is absent) writes with `SEED_WRITE_OPTIONS`, stamps nothing and has no organization; untouched.
- A person resolves through membership only; `sys_member` declares no validity columns today, so "member" is "holds a row in the organization".
- Platform-managed tables with no organization column (identity, auth and engine tables other than `sys_user` and `sys_organization`) keep the filtered probe on an organization's load; it is refused and now said once. No scope rule is invented for them.
- The `single` boot, a publish and a hot reload probe references unscoped, as before; only their write context gains the sole organization.
